message.reasoning:
We need to fix compilation errors. The test class is trying to use JUnit 5 annotations (BeforeEach, Test) but imports are missing. Instead of pulling JUnit, we can replace these with our own simple methods; we can remove annotations and imports. Since test runner not required, we just need the code to compile. Also remove Mockito dependencies.

Main issues: SimpleBar and other classes not implementing all abstract methods of Bar and BarSeries. Let's inspect Bar interface from ta4j core. We need to know required methods. Likely Bar has many methods: getOpenPrice, getHighPrice, getLowPrice, getClosePrice, getVolume, getAmount, getTrades, getTimestamp, getBeginTime?, getEndTime?, isCompleted, addPrice, addTrade. The errors show missing getBeginTime in SimpleBar and BarWithNullCloseSeries' anonymous Bar. In our implementation, we omitted getBeginTime. Also BarSeries interface includes methods like addBar(Duration, ZonedDateTime, Num, Num, Num, Num, Num, Num) etc. The test's MockBarSeries missing that method.

Simpler approach: Instead of fully implementing Bar and BarSeries, we can make our test class extend from existing implementations provided by ta4j library, but maybe not available. Better to make our SimpleBar implement Bar with default stub for getBeginTime().

Also BarSeries missing many methods. Instead, we could make MockBarSeries extend from a concrete class in library e.g., BaseBarSeries, but not sure available. Safer: implement required methods with dummy implementations.

We need to know BarSeries abstract methods: Based on errors, abstract method addBar(Duration, ZonedDateTime, Num, Num, Num, Num, Num, Num). Also possibly other methods: getBarData, getBarDuration, getBeginTime, getEndTime, getName, copy, getSubSeries, addPrice, addTrade. Already many implemented but missing addBar with many parameters. Also maybe getBarCount, getBar, getBarSeries interface may have methods like getBar(int), getBarCount, getBarData, getName etc. We'll add a default implementation of addBar with that signature that throws UnsupportedOperationException.

Similarly for NullBarSeries, BarWithNullCloseSeries, FaultySeries, need to implement addBar(Duration,...). We'll add.

Also need getBeginTime() in Bar interface; SimpleBar and anonymous Bar need to implement it (return null or throw). For simplicity return null.

Same for BarWithNullCloseSeries anonymous Bar: we need to add getBeginTime method stub.

Also the test class uses @BeforeEach which is JUnit 5. We can replace with @Before (JUnit 4) maybe. However we removed imports; we can just use a regular method called setupBeforeEach and call it manually in tests. Since tests are manually invoked from main and also annotated with @Test but not used. We can just keep but remove annotation imports and annotations to avoid compile errors. So remove @BeforeEach annotation and @Test annotation. Also remove import statements for JUnit and Mockito.

Simplify: Delete import lines for JUnit and Mockito, and remove the annotations in code (or comment them). Keep method signatures.

Also methods assertEquals defined earlier accept three parameters; tests call two arguments, missing message. We can overload assertEquals with two-arg version calling three-arg with empty message. Add overloaded methods.

Similarly assertThrows is defined expecting three arguments (Class, Runnable, String), tests pass only two. Provide overloaded version with default message.

Also tests call assertEquals with expected DecimalNum and actual Num; they use our overloaded method.

Add overloaded methods:

private static void assertEquals(Object expected, Object actual) { assertEquals(expected, actual, ""); }

Similarly for assertThrows.

Also they call assertNotNull already defined.

Also test code uses assertTrue already defined.

Add missing import for Duration, ZonedDateTime already present.

Need to add getBeginTime method to Bar implementations.

Implement in SimpleBar:

@Override public ZonedDateTime getBeginTime() { throw new UnsupportedOperationException(); } // or return null

But Bar interface may have getBeginTime method returning ZonedDateTime. We'll add.

Also need to add method in anonymous Bar of BarWithNullCloseSeries.

Add override.

Add addBar method to BarSeries implementations:

public void addBar(Duration duration, ZonedDateTime endTime, Num openPrice, Num highPrice, Num lowPrice, Num closePrice, Num volume, Num amount) { // no op or add new SimpleBar(closePrice) maybe
    bars.add(new SimpleBar(closePrice));
}

Similarly for others, we can implement as unsupported.

But test only uses addBar(Bar bar) in MockBarSeries (custom method) not the interface method. So implementing with empty bodies is fine.

Also need to implement getBarData maybe not needed.

Now adjust imports: remove unused imports.

Let's craft corrected code.
